entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please say 'Sales' or 'Support' to be connected.
Connecting you to a support agent now.
Thank you for calling VeloFit support. My name is David. How can I help you today?
Hi... I... I think I need to return something? I bought these cycling shoes a while ago and I'm just so confused by the website.
I can certainly help you with that. Do you have your order number handy?
Oh, um, yes, I think it's... VF88675309.
Great, thank you. Let me just pull that up... Okay, I see the order for the VeloFit Pro cycling shoes, delivered on October 15th. So about 59 days ago. Is that correct?
Yes, that's them. I just... I don't think they're for me. I tried to find the policy online but it was all very overwhelming. Can't you just help me?

Of course. I'm here to make this as easy as possible. Just so I can note it down correctly, was there a specific issue with the shoes? For instance, did they cause blisters or was there a problem with attaching the cleats?
I think I did get blisters the one time I tried them. The cleats... I don't even know what those are. I just know they weren't right. I'd really just like to get a refund if I can.

I completely understand, and I'm very sorry they weren't comfortable for you. I've reviewed your order, and you are well within our 90-day return period. I can absolutely process this return for you right now.
Oh! Really? It's that simple? That's such a relief. Thank you.

It's my pleasure. And I see here you're one of our VIP members. For the trouble you've had, and to thank you for your loyalty, I've gone ahead and added a $15 credit to your account for your next purchase. I've also just processed the return; you should see an email with a pre-paid shipping label within the next five minutes.
Wow, that's so nice of you! A credit too? You've been a huge help, David. Thank you so much.
You are very welcome. Once we receive the shoes back at our warehouse, your full refund will be processed. Is there anything else I can help you with today?
No, that's everything. Thank you again!
Happy to help. Thank you for being a VeloFit member, and have a great rest of your day.
